Global

For years, the United Nations system has shaped the global discussion of how the internet should be governed. Through multilateral spaces (such as the ITU) and multi-stakeholder spaces like the Internet Governance Forum, the global standard-setting system has always played a preponderant role over the principles that guide states when regulating the flow of information online.
